Popular Easy Treks in Nepal

Manang Trek – 9 Days

Manang, the hidden valley of South Asia is one of the most popular easy treks in Nepal.

Manang Trek is also a top choice of fellow travelers who want to go far from home but still would like to experience it in a short amount of time. With only 250 km away from Kathmandu, this destination takes a short time to reach and is still budget friendly.

Many trekkers who have to go further on their traveling destination also stop at Manang for overnight stay. Shangri-La, a village in Manang is the last trekking stop for those trekkers. In fact, this is the stop for travelers in the Annapurna region.

Manang offers you a unique experience of the lifestyle of the locals here. The local people are very good traders. The trading happens in and out of Manang and you get to experience a different side of day to day living of people.

Moreover, Manang has two parts: northern and southern. The northern part is like a village, there are no facilities like the ones we have in cities. Whereas, the southern part has lots of access that are also in the cities.

You can enjoy two sides of the same place. There is a route that connects Manang to Mustang via Thorung La Pass. This pass is between Manang and Muktinath.

Enjoy the hidden valley and make the most out of your holiday.

Ghorepani Poon Hill Trek – 8 Days

Ghorepani Poon Hill Trek is a very popular easy trek in Nepal that most of the family plan to go together. This trek amidst the Annapurna region is popular for the view of sunrise and sunset that you get to see from Poon Hill.

After reaching the final destination, you will witness the majestic views of Annapurna mountain ranges. The Annapurna I, Annapurna II, Annapurna III, Dhaulagiri, Machhapuchhre, Nilgiri, Tukuche are spectacular.

A lot of families choose to go on this trek together and they have an incredible time together. This trek can take only 8 days and is still a short time to experience so much more than expected.

Starting the journey from Pokhara, you walk along waterfalls and lush forests. The Gurung community in the beautiful village of Ghandruk is worth experiencing.

Panchase Trek – 4 Days

Panchase Trek is also another delightful yet easy trek amidst the Annapurna region. Panchase lies in the western part of Nepal and is the highest hill in the region. Like Poon Hill, Panchase is also popular for the view of sunrise and sunset over the Himalayan ranges.

Annapurna region is a community of Gurung people. So, you will get to see the Gurung lifestyle, culture, tradition, and religion in Panchase.

Panchase trek is in the outskirts of Pokhara. Pokhara is heaven for travel enthusiasts who want to travel the Annapurna region. This is also the last place for travelers to relax after their journey.

On the outskirts of Pokhara, you will get a chance to explore the lush greenery. If you are a nature lover then this is the trek you need. The outskirts are a completely different experience than the ones in Lakeside.

From Pokhara, you can catch a glimpse of mountain ranges like Annapurna South, Himchuli and Machhapuchhre. Panchase trek is a great opportunity for those who want to connect with the locals here and nature.

Everest View Trek – 9 Days

Everest View Trek is a mini version of witnessing the highest mountain in the world. For those of you who do not want to or cannot trek to the Everest Base Camp can choose this one.

Yes, it is still an easy trek because of how less effort you have to give to experience something huge and unforgettable. Taking the Everest View Trek will offer you a closer view of Everest and other Khumbu mountains.

The journey begins with a flight from Kathmandu to Lukla. You will then head to Sagarmatha National Park to witness the rare species of flora and fauna.

Sagarmatha National Park, the second most popular trekking area in Nepal will give you the relaxation of nature. Walking through rhododendron forests and pine forests lead you to Namche Bazaar.

This 9 days trekking plan will need an acclimatization day. So, you will have the day in the gorgeous land of the Sherpas, Namche Bazaar. You will explore the lifestyle of the Sherpas along with a different way of Buddhism that they follow.

Speaking of the views, besides the majestic Mount Everest, you also have an opportunity to witness other mountains. You can see Lhotse, Amadablam, Nuptse, Thamserku, Kangtega, Kusum, Kangaru, Malaphula, Tawoche, etc.

From Namche Bazaar you will walk past other Sherpa villages like Khunde and Khumjung. Then, you will come back to Lukla and take a flight back to Kathmandu.

Chisapani Nagarkot Trek – 6 Days

The Chisapani Nagarkot Trek is one of the nearest destinations from Kathmandu Valley. With only 23 km away from the north east of Kathmandu, you will walk past the trails of Shivapuri National Park.

This 6 days trek is for nature lovers. You will be walking in the lush forest with a variety of species of flowers. You can also spot some of the unique birds in the trails of Shivapuri.

The foggy view of Nagarkot will add another feel to the trek.

Get lost in the refreshing wind that the forest gives and experience the wildlife of nature with this Chisapani Nagarkot Trek. The altitude is only 2,300 m and you can witness the Annapurna range from Nagarkot.

You can visit the Nagarkot View Tower and catch the glimpse of mountains like Ganesh Himal, Langtang, Dorje Lakpa and Gauri Shankar. The view is mesmerizing from the view tower and the feeling is amazing as the fresh hair fits you in the morning.

This trek is also one of the best options for food and accommodation. There are plenty of food options from local to international dishes that will excite your taste buds. The hotels are some of the best places you can choose to enjoy an unforgettable moment with your company.

Also, the weather will make you fall in love with Nagarkot.

To Conclude,

You do not have to know about the ‘world famous’ destinations in Nepal to have a wonderful time. You can still have the best of the situation with less time and less budget.

Easy treks in Nepal will give you the taste of what you want and it will make you come back for more.

Whether it is for a quick getaway or a holiday, only a certain place does not define the true magic of trekking. These destinations are bound to give you all the aspects of traveling.

title: Things to See in Nepal
excerpt: Nepal is a small yet, diverse country. There are a lot of things to see in Nepal if you are planning your next visit here in this land of diversity. With all the attractions that are within the…
html:
Nepal is a small yet, diverse country. There are a lot of things to see in Nepal if you are planning your next visit here in this land of diversity.

With all the attractions that are within the boundary of Nepal, your time here will be worthy and what you see is enchanting.

The things that you can see in Nepal are not only of one kind. To be specific, there are a lot of variations you can see and the options are endless. Let’s find out some of the musts to see in Nepal.

Mountains and Lakes

Nepal is famous for the mountains that it has. The widest number of mountains are all in Nepal including the highest one, Mount Everest as well. Along with the roof of the world, Nepal also has other popular mountain peaks.

Many people visit Nepal to enjoy the view from the lap of the mountains. Moreover, along with the view of the mountains the lakes in the higher elevations equally fascinate you. World’s highest peak, Tilicho lake is also in Nepal. But with a descend, there is Rara Lake as well.

You can check out some of the packages that include seeing the mountains and lakes in Nepal:

Everest Base Camp Trek – 15 days

Everest Base Camp Trek is that dream trek which gives you a once in a lifetime experience. It gives you an opportunity to witness the highest mountain in the world, Mount Everest.

Everest Base Camp Trek is also that one trek which consists of the finest mountain vistas. This dream trek also has a good fusion of culture of locals, lush forests and the holy shrines.

Starting the journey from an adventures flight to Lukla airport, you will encounter the gorgeous views already.

Every year thousands of trekkers come to Nepal to witness the high mountains as they stand tall.

With acclimatization in Namche Bazaar to the serene peace in Tengboche, the journey gives you more than just views. It is a kind of spiritual tour as well.

You will walk past other natural resources like rivers, waterfalls and other lush forests. Upon reaching Kala Patthar, you will have the best view you have ever seen of Mount Everest.

Please submit your inquiry using the form below. Our team will get back to you as soon as possible.

Annapurna Base Camp Trek – 13 Days

Annapurna Base Camp Trek is one of the most popular trekking destinations in the world. This 13 days trek is a moderately difficult trek. The route also takes you through the Machhapuchhre Base Camp Trek.

The journey begins from Pokhara with a drive to Nayapul. You will ascend to Poon Hill via the beautiful Gurung village, Ghandruk. Poon Hill being the photographer’s paradise is not the end. You will walk past Machhapuchhre Base Camp and only then you will reach the Annapurna Base Camp.

You get a chance to see a lot of the mountain ranges. The Annapurna I, II, III, IV, Annapurna South, Dhaulagiri, Nilgiri, and Lamjung Himal. The panoramic beauty will leave you awestruck.

Like the Everest Base Camp Trek, this trek also has the beauty of culture, natural beauty and more. The Gurungs and Magars are delightful and will make the journey more interesting. In the end, you will have nothing but good memories.

Gokyo Valley Trek – 13 Days

Gokyo Lake is one of the most popular lakes in Nepal. The Gokyo Valley Trek is a 13 days trek that takes you on the tour to one of the finest places in the Everest Region. Gokyo Valley Trek is for the adventure seekers who want a bit of thrill in their journey.

With moderate difficulty grade, you do not need a professional trekking experience for this trek. Good health and proper training before the trek will do the job.

Since this trek is in the Everest region, the Sherpas are one of the main highlights that make the journey more beautiful. They are friendly and their simple lifestyle is a matter of charm. With their welcoming behavior, you will build an unforgettable bond with them.

Gokyo Valley is in the base of 19 lakes in total. 6 among the 19 holds high importance because of their size and depths. They are the world’s highest freshwater lake.

The trek takes you on the trails of Dudh Koshi river. You will also walk past the lush forests of the Khumbu region where there is the highest glacier in the world. The Sherpa inhabitants are everywhere in the Everest region and the ambiance of the Himalayas will add a glorious feeling.

Tilicho Lake Trekking – 17 Days

Tilicho Lake is in the Annapurna Region of Nepal. With a beautiful destination that it is, Tilicho Lake Trekking is also one of the most fascinating trekking destinations of Nepal. With its unique and adventurous route, this trek will add thrill and excitement to your journey.

Tilicho Lake is the lake at the highest altitude in the world. This 17 days trek has the same route as the one in Annapurna circuit as it is in the Annapurna region.

You will walk in the trails of the Marshyangdi river, reach Manang, Khangsar and then you will reach the gorgeous Tilicho Lake. You also have to walk past the highest pass in Nepal. This is the toughest trail and is the real thrill of the trek.

Besides Tilicho Lake, you will also witness the gorgeous mountain vistas of the Annapurna region. Trekking to the Tilicho Lake will offer you an amazing time with some of the amazing villages of Manang. The locals there are friendly and will show you a different world that they live in.

Jumla Rara Lake Trek – 17 Days

This 17 days Jumla Rara Lake Trek is inside Rara National Park. It is the smallest National Park of Nepal. This trek will not only show you the beautiful Rara Lake but also the nature of Nepal.

The journey begins from Jumla. After passing through the beautiful and lush forest of Jumla, you will reach the Rara National Park. Unlike the other treks where you have to climb up, this trek actually demands you to climb down the hills.

You do not have to worry about the altitude sickness in this trek as it is in the elevation of 2,290 m above sea level only. Regardless, you will also get to see the beautiful mountain ranges in the background.

Langtang Gosaikunda Trek – 14 Days

With only 41.5 km away from Kathmandu, the Langtang Gosaikunda Trek is one of the nearest destinations you can go to.

Gosaikunda Lake is without a doubt one of the most beautiful lakes you can see in Nepal. And what makes it better is that it is in one of the nearest valleys from Kathmandu, Langtang Valley. This is a very good option to spend your holidays for 14 days to take a break from your busy lifestyle in Kathmandu.

From Syabrubesi, you will walk via the Langtang river which will eventually lead you to the Tibetan border. Continuing past the settlement of the Tamangs, you will then reach Kyanjin Gompa, a sacred monastery of Langtang Valley.

After that, you will head to the Thulo Syabru and Shin Gompa.

Gosaikunda Lake doesn’t only please our eyes. But it is also a sacred lake for the Hindus and Buddhists. There is a belief that whoever takes a bath in the holy lake will free them from all their sins.

The beauty of the lake is also enhanced by the gorgeous mountain vistas of Langtang region. The serenity after the trek will refresh your mind and reduce all your stress.

How to Enjoy the Scenic Views of Mountains and Lakes?

To witness all the magical sights of the mountains and lakes, you have to trek and it is a once in a lifetime experience.

If you are not into trekking, you can also opt for a mesmerizing helicopter rides. We have options for helicopter rides that also takes less time than trekking for many days.

Speaking of a shorter number of days, you can have a day tour on a helicopter for some of your desired destinations.

But if you really are into trekking, there are other peak climbing options we have too. And if you choose a favorable season then you might get a chance to experience some mountain expeditions as well.

Festivities, Culture, and People

Festivities, culture, and people are some of the best ways to know about a certain landmark.

Nepal is a land of cultural diversity and has some of the richest cultures here. With the diverse culture comes their own festivities, norms, and tradition.

Like all the other landscapes and sights to see, the festivities, culture, and people are also some of the finest things to see in Nepal.

There are also many festivals in a year that you get to experience in their own season. The biggest festival in Nepal, Dashain falls in one of the peak seasons of fall. Likewise, there are many festivals that Nepalese celebrate in different parts of the world in their own way.

People belonging to different ethnic groups are also a fascinating thing to see. They have their own attire that defines them and you can still see them wearing and flaunting those attires sometimes even in this modern era.

Moreover, witnessing their lifestyles in a closer perspective is captivating. Their welcoming nature with warm hospitality is commendable. Experiencing the festivals and the rich culture of the people from different parts of Nepal are memorable.

Tamang Heritage Trek – 10 Days

First, we have the Tamang Heritage Trek, a destination in Langtang region that will show you the beautiful Tamang traditions. This trek will take you to the simple yet fascinating villages of Tamang people who live there.

This cultural exploration will help you explore the lifestyle of the Tamang Village. The alpine forests, mid-hill and the scene of the Langtang Himal add a minimal feel. You will experience the culture, tradition and the lifestyle of Tamang people in this trek.

Their daily living style includes different means as infrastructures. Trading is their main source of earning and activities like cattle raising and farming are common there.

Trekking in the Langtang region is not so far from Kathmandu and you can get a lot to experience from the simplicity and the struggle of the locals.

Ghorepani Poon Hill Trek – 8 Days

Ghorepani Poon Hill Trek is popular for the sunrise and sunset views you get to see from there. But there are also a lot of different things to see in the Gurung community living there. The rich Gurung and Magar culture is easily visible there with their own styles of daily life.

This 8 days trek is suitable for all age group and good to trek with family and children.

Even though this destination is for the panoramic views of Annapurna mountains, you will also see much more from the Gurung community. So it is the best way to learn about them by visiting their community.

Jomsom Muktinath Trek – 12 Days

Jomsom Muktinath Trek is another option for travelers who are more on the religious side. Muktinath Temple is the main highlight of this trek, but there are also other aspects that you can enjoy.

The culture, flora and fauna, and the Thakali people will add so much more to your journey.

Villages in Jomsom, Kagbeni, and Marpha will help you interact with the locals. The best way to learn and understand the people and their culture is by talking to the locals.

Muktinath Temple is another highly important temple. People believe that washing your body from the holy water there will wash away all your sins.

It is one of the best places to see people and their culture there. Along with that, you will enjoy the picturesque view of the mountain ranges.

Mustang Tiji Festival Trek – 18 Days

Festivals can be mesmerizing, especially when you get to experience one from a different place. Even though different parts of Nepal have different festivals with the time you choose to visit, Tiji Festival is a separate package.

The Mustang Tiji Festival will take you on an 18 days journey. It will allow you to experience the most colourful festival in Upper Mustang.

It is an annual festival native to the Lo Manthang. The people there celebrate the festival to ask the gods for good crops and water.

How to Explore People and Cultures in Nepal?

You can visit different communities in Nepal composing people with their own ethnicity. By doing this, you can get to see and learn about their lifestyle.

Every community has its own authenticity in different aspects. Their cultures vary and the festivals they celebrate are different. Some even have their own language.

At higher elevations, you will see Buddhist monasteries and shrines this is due to influence of Buddhism. Whereas in the lower elevations there are more Hindu temples.

Regardless, there is still a mixture of all the religious sites in every region.

The people living in their own community also specialize in their own local food.

History and Ancient Artifacts

With all the advancements come history and arts. History and art show not only a reality but also the beliefs of older generations that are still alive now.

So the architecture, old sculpting, heritage sites, and museums are also important aspects in Nepal to see.

From UNESCO World Heritage sites to the artifacts in the museum, you have so much to see in Nepal. All the ancient monuments are the older architectural treasures. Even in the temples, you can see the carvings and other forms of arts.

Regardless, everything that is from the old days is worth seeing. If you seek interest in old arts and history then you will love it.

Nepal Historical Tours

If you are someone who wants to learn the history of Nepal with the old arts and ancient monuments then the Nepal Historical Tours is one of them. Nepal has a lot of places with their own historical importance.

It also gives you a spiritual background of Nepal. The historical tour begins from the capital city Kathmandu. The old myths and story are mesmerizing as you take a tour with detail information about the ground you are standing on.

Nepal Heritage Tour

Nepal Heritage Tour takes you on the architectural beauty of the ancient monuments of Nepal. With the top 10 UNESCO World Heritage sites, you will see the history through the ancient architect.

The architectural sites have their own styles and it is always a good idea to see and learn about it. The heritage sites include Kathmandu Durbar Square, Boudha Stupa, Patan Durbar Square and more.

If you are into the old buildings reflecting the culture and religion of people then this tour is perfect for you.

This journey includes Lumbini and many parts of Nepal that describes the history and the ancient style of architecture.

Nepal Cultural Tour

As culturally rich as Nepal is, this tour takes you on a background of all these cultures. Nepal is a land of diversity in the ethnic groups and their backgrounds. Even though Nepal is a small country, there are more than 100 ethnic groups.

Each of the ethnic groups holds their own authentic values and norms. These have been going on for a really long time. Nepal Cultural Tour takes you on a new experience every day.

Kathmandu, Patan, Bhaktapur, Nagarkot, Chitwan, and Pokhara are some of the parts of this tour. Every place has its own monuments, architectural speciality, and their own people. Every day is a different experience with this tour.

Why Historical Tours in Nepal?

With watching the history of ancient artifacts, you can know about the varieties of Nepal. From kings and queens to the architectural talent of Nepal, you can also learn the history and the transition of the people and other customs.

The history and artifacts also show the religion and traditions of people. The diversity and their details are also shown in museums. Visiting these museums are easily possible when you stroll around during buffer days.

You can also choose our packages to visit the places that have a lot of old arts and artifacts.

Wildlife and Nature

If you are a nature lover, then this is the best thing you can experience in Nepal. There are many species of flora and fauna that you can enjoy in Nepal.

Likewise, there are other rare species of animals like clouded leopard, red panda, Bengal tiger, rhinoceros and more. Enjoying in the lush forests of Nepal will give you an opportunity to witness these natural beauties.

With the right season, you can spot the wildlife of Nepal. There are many packages that specialize in wildlife and nature of Nepal. All these packages are perfect for spending quality time with your friends and family.

Nepal Jungle Safari Tours

Nepal Jungle Safari Tours include the most amazing trips as it is rich in biodiversity. The natural environment gives a chance to adventure seekers to explore the forests and the nature of Nepal.

You can enjoy this tour with your family and children. The Terai region will offer you the beauty that the wildlife gives. You can see animals like swamp deer, musk deer, blue bull, royal Bengal tiger, gharial, wild buffalo and more.

You can also spot birds like peacocks, koels, and drongos. Some of the best places are the Chitwan National Park and Bardia National Park.

The jungle safari tour is one of the best ways to enjoy your holidays and have fun. Our expertise from Base Camp Adventures will guide you throughout the trek and you will enjoy every part of it.

Things You can Do During Wildlife Tours

You can also do a lot of fun activities to watch the wildlife and nature of Nepal. One of the most popular activities is jungle safari. In a jungle safari, you can watch the wildlife in a closer view. You can watch the animals enjoying their time as you drive passing by their side.

Furthermore, you can also join on a rafting adventure to enjoy the waving rivers of Nepal.

Rafting is also an adventure sport here and you will enjoy thoroughly. For Rafting you can choose Marshyangdi River Rafting, Kali Gandaki River Rafting, Sunkoshi River Rafting or more.

What You Get After Nepal Tour?

After your tour, you will learn about the history, geography, culture, what makes Nepal complete.

With that comes a lot of memories, whether it’s celebrating a certain festival with the locals or making new friends along the way.

You can always choose different activities or create your own in between seeing all the gorgeous things Nepal has.

If there is anything you would like to know more about or talk to us about what you want to see, then contact us.

title: 8 Days Treks in Nepal
excerpt: A mountainous country and the land of Himalayas, Nepal is one of the ideal destinations to plan your treks. From trekking trails to the duration of the trek and level of difficulty, there are various…
html:
A mountainous country and the land of Himalayas, Nepal is one of the ideal destinations to plan your treks.

From trekking trails to the duration of the trek and level of difficulty, there are various options to choose. Depending on your vacation and timing, trekkers can choose the package that best suits them.

The 8 days treks in Nepal is great for both novice and experienced trekkers and perfectly serves the purpose of trekking.

Most of the 8 days treks take you up to an altitude of 4,000 m where you will get to enjoy the panoramic view of the mountains.

Not only that, but you will also get to witness the diverse culture and lifestyle of the Nepalese people while trekking. During the 8 days trek, you will have to walk around 5 to 6 hours per day and these packages are budget-friendly as well.

Now allow us to give you an overview of some of the 8 days treks in Nepal. However, please note that you can modify all these packages according to your need and preference.

Everest Panorama Trek

Everest Panorama Trek is an easy trek in the Everest region which takes you high up along the trails to Tengboche Monastery(3,850 m). Hence, they also call it Tengboche trekking.

This trek offers the splendid view of Mt.Everest including Everest, Lhotse, Thamserku, Ama Dablam, and many other snowy peaks.

This Everest Panorama trek suits best to those who are short on time and do not have the energy to go all the way up to the Everest Base Camp yet, wish to see the tallest peak of Mt.Everest with a parade of satellite peaks all around.

During this trek, you will also get the chance to explore the wonderful Sherpa culture and tradition at first hand.

During the 8 days, you can visit the traditional beautiful villages, witness dense rhododendron, pine, and fir forest. And old monasteries while capturing breathtaking views of the Himalayas.

Highlights of the Trek

  • Short trip to explore the Everest region
  • Stunning views of mountains in the Everest region
  • Experience the rich Sherpa Culture and lifestyle
  • Less strenuous and best for those who may have high altitude problems.

Trip Itinerary

Day 1: Fly to Lukla and Trek to Phakding, walking distance 4 Hours

Day 2: Trek to Namche Bazaar 3,440 m, walking distance 6 Hours

Day 3: Acclimatization Day in Namche Bazaar

Day 4: Trek to Tengboche 3,800 m, walking distance 5 Hours

Day 5: Trek to Kyangjuma (3,570 m), walking distance 4 – 5 hours

Day 6: Trek to Monjo 2,840 m

Day 7: Trek to Lukla

Day 8: Fly back to Kathmandu

Please submit your inquiry using the form below. Our team will get back to you as soon as possible.

Annapurna Panorama View Trek

Annapurna Panorama Trek also known as Ghorepani Poon Hill trek is a short and an ideal trekking route in the Annapurna region. This trek introduces you to panoramic mountain views of the spectacular mountains. The Annapurna, Dhaulagiri, Nilgiri, Himchuli, Macchapucchre are some of the peaks.

This trek is easily accessible from Pokhara. The highest point of the trek is Poon Hill situated at 3,210 m above the sea level. Here one can enjoy a glorious sunrise and a 360-degree panoramic view of the spectacular mountains.

During the trek, you will walk through the beautiful settlements of Gurung, Thakali and Magar. Alongside with lush forests of rhododendron, oak, and terraced fields.

In addition, the trail as you follow up and down the staircase, this trek is relatively an easy trek.

Highlights of the Trek

  • Scenic hike through the subtropical in Nepal Himalayas
  • Breathtaking mountains view of Annapurna Himalayas
  • Stunning sunrise view over the grand Himalaya ranges
  • Observe the lifestyle of Gurung community

Trip Itinerary

Day 01: Arrival in Kathmandu 1,350 m

Day 02: Kathmandu valley sightseeing Tour and Preparation day for Trek

Day 03: Kathmandu – Pokhara 850 m, 7 hrs drive by tourist bus

Day 04: Drive from Pokhara to Nayapul and trek to Tikhedhunga(1,530 m), 4 hrs

Day 05: Trek from Tikhedhunga to Ghorepani (2,850 m), 6 hrs

Day 06: Hike to Poon Hill viewpoint 45 m (3,210 m) then trek to Ghandruk (1,950 m), 6/7 hrs

Day 07: Trek from Ghandruk to Nayapul (1,050 m) 4 hrs walk, and 1 hrs drive to Pokhara (820 m)

Day 08: Drive back to Kathmandu 7/8 hrs by tourist bus

Khopra Danda Trek

Khopra Danda trek is the new off the beaten trekking route in Annapurna region which is a great option for 8 days treks in Nepal. This trek also has alternative names like Kopra Ridge and Khayer lake trekking.

If you want to avoid the crowd of the Annapurna region, this is the perfect scenic trek. In this trek, you will have a peaceful experience in the less explored trails. Despite the short duration, this trek lets you enjoy the beautiful untouched nature.

Moreover, during this trek, you will cross beautiful Magar, Gurung, Kami, and Brahmin villages. With this, you will get the chance to observe the real Nepali lifestyle ( their culture, art of living and religion).

This trek is suitable both for beginners and experienced. While most parts of the trails are strenuous, some parts are easy. This path will take you through lush pine, oak, rhododendron, and bamboo forest.

Moreover, in this trek, you will hike up to Khayer lake at 4,600 m This is the highest point with the most spectacular views of mountain peaks and landscapes.

The best time to take this trek is during Spring and Autumn. However, you can still trek during another season which offers more peace and solitude time with nature. Overall Khopra Danda trek is one of the great short treks in Nepal.

Highlights of the Trek

  • Panoramic and close-up view of Annapurna Massifs
  • Witness unobstructed sunrise and sunset views from Poon Hill viewpoint.
  • Enjoy the newly opened, less crowded trekking within unspoiled nature.
  • Experience the lifestyle and culture of Magar and Gurung people.
  • Walk through dense jungle, Rhododendron flowers, waterfalls, etc.
  • A side trip to Khayar Lake.
  • A unique experience of natural hot spring on the bank of Kaligandaki River.

Trip Itinerary

Day 01: Fly to Pokhara from Ktm, Drive to Nayapul, Trek to Tikhedhunga/Ulleri 1,488 m, 2-3hrs

Day 02: Trek to Ghorepani 2,875 m, 4-5 hrs

Day 03: Trek to Upper Chistibung3,000 m, 5-6 hrs

Day 04: Trek to Khopra Danda 3,640 m, 3-hrs

Day 05: Rest day in Khopra Danda, Day trip to Khayer Lake 4,660 m, 6-hrs

Day 06: Trek to Tatopani 1,250 m, 4-5 hrs

Day 07: Drive to Pokhara 815 m, 4 hrs

Day 08: Fly or drive to Kathmandu 1,400 m, 35 minutes/ 6-7 Hrs

Langtang Valley Trek

Langtang valley is a beautiful valley to the north of Kathmandu with just a few hours of drive. The whole valley gives a spectacular view of Mount Langtang Lirung. Moreover, this trek offers a view of dense forests, swift mountain streams, high grasslands, and snow-capped peaks.

Despite being close to Kathmandu, this valley is remote and remains untouched by modernization. Besides the impressive scenic landscape and mountain views, the Langtang Valley trekking is popular for its biodiversity.

This trek is a perfect getaway for those trekkers who seek solitude and peace.

Close to the Tibetan border, this area also lets you experience the Tibetan culture and their lifestyle. During the trek, you will come across Kyanjin Gompa which is an important checkpoint. Here you can see the marvelous art and culture of Buddhist monasteries.

So with its picturesque landscapes, moderate climate, easy trails, and traditional lifestyles. Langtang valley trek is one of the gems of the Himalayan country, Nepal.

Highlights of the trek

  • Scenic drive from Kathmandu to Syabrubesi via mountain terrain
  • Langtang Gompa and Kyanjin Gompa, old Buddhist shrines
  • Climbing Tserko-Ri
  • Panoramic view of Mt. Langtang-Ri, Langsisa, Langtang Himal, Ganjala peak
  • Experience Tibetan Buddhist Culture
  • Walk through the rhododendron forest.

Trip Itinerary

Day 01: Drive from Kathmandu to Syarubesi (1,462 m), 7 Hour

Day 02: Trek to Lama Hotel (2,510 m), 5 Hour

Day 03: Trek to Langtang Village (3,307 m), 5 Hour

Day 04: Trek to Kyanjin Gompa (3,798 m), 3-4 Hour

Day 05: Trek to Tserko Ri (4,900 m)

Day 06: Trek to Lama Hotel, 5 Hour

Day 07: Trek to Syabrubesi, 5 Hour

Day 08: Drive back to Kathmandu

Gosaikunda Lake trek

The Gosaikunda lake trek lies in the north of Kathmandu valley in the Langtang region. It is at an elevation of 4,380 m

This trek takes you through remote Langtang valley to serene high altitude freshwater lakes of Gosaikunda. Not only is this site a popular trekking destination, but it is also considered holy shrine for both Buddhists and Hindus.

Hence many people visit this place for pilgrimage esp in Janai Purnima that takes place in the month of August.

On this week-long trek, you will get the dramatic views of Mt Manaslu, Ganesh Himal, Tibetan peaks, and Langtang Lirung. Also, you will pass through the alpine forest. It is full of blooming rhododendrons and evergreen forest.

Moreover, you will also be spellbound by the beauty of lakes of Gosaikunda, Saraswati Kunda and Bhairab Kunda.

Overall this trek is great for people who have a fascination for culture and mythology as well as a passion for mountains. For longer duration, you can check our 14 days Langtang Gosaikunda trek.

Highlights of the trek

  • Scenic drive from Kathmandu to Syabrubesi
  • Witness the holy lakes of Gosaikunda (4,360 m)
  • Exotic Himalayan view
  • Tamang cultures & lifestyles
  • Unique flora & fauna

Trip Itinerary

Day 01: Drive from Kathmandu to Syabrubesi 1,550 m, 7-8 hrs

Day 02: Trek to Lama Hotel 2,380 m, 6 hrs

Day 03: Lama Hotel to Thulo Syabru 2,330 m, 5-6 hrs

Day 04: Thulo Syabru to Shin Gompa 3,330 m, 4-5 hrs

Day 05: Shin Gompa to Gosaikunda 4,460 m, 5-6 hrs

Day 06: Gosaikunda to Chandanbari 2,000 m, 5 hrs

Day 07: Chandanbari to Dhunche 1,300 m, 6 hrs

Day 08: Dhunche to Kathmandu (drive) 1,380 m, 6 hrs

Things to Consider for 8 Days Treks in Nepal

While trekking in Nepal can be fun and adventurous, it is very important that you prepare well prior to the trek. Here are some tips that can come handy for a safe and comfortable trekking experience.

  • Choose a suitable season and pack accordingly
  • Trekking requires a very good pair of footwear that you can count on. You should prepare for any kind of terrain that you might come across.
  • While trekking, it is very important to drink plenty of water and stay hydrated. This will minimize the risk of altitude sickness as you climb higher.
  • Maintain your own pace and do not rush.
  • Good physical fitness is important. Hence, you should prepare yourself physically and mentally.
  • Educate yourself about Acute Mountain sickness (AMS) and take the necessary precautions.
  • Avoid drinking alcohol while trekking as it can cause dehydration.
  • In the remote area, there are no ATMs, hence carry enough cash to last you for the days that you are in the mountains.
  • If you prefer peace and solitude, choose off-season i.e Summer or winter
  • Book your flight and hotel in advance if you plan to trek in the peak season.
  • Keep extra days in case of any unplanned situation.

Conclusion

Nepal is a perfect trekking destination and it is every trekker’s dream to trek in this beautiful mountainous country.

Here you can find and choose among the easy trekking routes as well as the toughest ones. If you are trekking for the first time, we recommend you try the easy and moderate category.

The list of treks above not only lets you enjoy the mesmerizing beauty of nature. But it also gives you an opportunity to learn about the lifestyle in rural areas.

Overall, these 8 days treks in Nepal are sure to give you a lifetime experience that you will cherish forever. For further question and queries, please feel free to contact us. It is our pleasure to guide and assist you with the best of our knowledge.

title: 5 Days Treks in Nepal
excerpt: Nepal is the most popular destination among trekkers. It offers a wide variety of treks to all types of trekking enthusiasts. Among several multi-day treks, the 5 days treks in Nepal offers the best…
html:
Nepal is the most popular destination among trekkers. It offers a wide variety of treks to all types of trekking enthusiasts.

Among several multi-day treks, the 5 days treks in Nepal offers the best chance for trekkers to explore the mysterious trails of Nepal in a short time. These 5 days treks in Nepal offers the best panoramic views of the Himalayas with an easy walking hour.

To do these treks, you don’t need prior experience. The 5-day trek is perfect and suitable for families, the elderly and children.

Although it is a short trek, you can extend days according to your interest in all of these treks. Now allow us to give you an overview on various 5 days trek in Nepal:

Everest View Trek

Everest View Trek also known as Everest Panorama Trek is one of the popular treks in Nepal. This trek will allow you to witness Mt Everest along with many impressive surrounding peaks.

During this trek, you will pass through the Sagarmatha National Park and pine forest, where rhododendron flowers grow. And you will find a diversity of wildlife.

This trek also introduces you with the largest Sherpa community in Namche Bazaar and Khumjung. Here, you will get to know the local Sherpa people, their culture and customs.

A 35-minute mountain flight from Kathmandu will take you to the Tenzing Hillary airport at Lukla, the gateway to Everest. From there, this 5 days Everest View Trek follows EBC trail through forest, farmland. And, Sherpa villages at a lower altitude that will help acclimatization.

On this trek, you will get spectacular views of mountains like Ama Dablam, Island peak, Everest, Nuptse, and Lhotse, etc.

This 5 days trek is convenient for those willing to explore the Everest region but have less time.

Trip Itinerary

Day 01: Flight to Lukla & Trek to Phakding (2,652 m): 8km, 3-4 hrs.

Day 02: Trek to Namche Bazaar (3,440 m): 10km, 5-6 hrs.

Day 03: Rest day, explore Khumjung Sherpa village and surrounding

Day 04: Namche Bazaar to Lukla (2,800 m): 18km, 7-8 hrs.

Day 05: Fly back to Kathmandu

Please submit your inquiry using the form below. Our team will get back to you as soon as possible.

Pikey Peak Trek

Pikey Peak trek is a new trekking route in Khumbu which invites you to explore the Everest and lower Khumbu region. It offers beautiful sunset and sunrise views over the nearby peaks. You will have a unique experience of Sherpa culture and lifestyle on this trek.

It includes a view of some of the most esteemed Himalayan ranges, Mt Everest, Kanchenjunga, Makalu, Lhotse, and many others. Being the new trekking route, it is less crowded and great for those who prefer peace and solitude.

Because this trek allows you to see the Everest without having to trek to high altitude, it is one of the best short treks in Nepal. The journey leads you to the Pikey base Camp with the widespread Buddhist culture along the way.

The lush valleys, old monasteries, huge mani walls, beautiful vegetation, amazing sunset are some of the highlights of this trek.

Hence with its tranquil landscapes, unique Sherpa culture, and stunning mountain views, this 5-day treks is one of a kind.

Trip Itinerary

Day 01: Drive to Dhap from Kathmandu and trek to Japre, 2,915 m, 5 hrs

Day 02: Trek from Japre to Pikey Base Camp, 3,640 m, 7 hrs

Day 03: Trek to Chaulakharka via Pikey Peak, 2,920 m, 6 hrs

Day 04: Trek from Chaulakharka to Shivalaya, 2,840 m, 6 hrs

Day 05: Drive from Shivalaya to Kathmandu, 1,400 m, 12 hrs

Ghorepani Poonhill Trek

Ghorepani Poonhill trek 5 days is the perfect option for trekkers who are willing to take a short trek. Although the trek only takes 5 days, you will get some of the most incredible views during the short period of time.

During the trek, you will walk through dense forests of rhododendron. Esp in Spring, the rhododendron flowers are in bloom that will make the trek even more beautiful.

The main highlight of this trek is the spectacular sunrise views over the Annapurna Himalayan range from the Poon Hill viewpoint.

From the top of the hill, you will get the astonishing 360-degree panoramic views of Annapurna Himalayan range, Mt. Macchapucchre, Hiunchuli, and Nilgiri. The trail also passes via several settlements inhabited by Gurung and Magar community.

Hence, this trek is an excellent opportunity for exploring and experiencing the culture and the nature of Annapurna region.

Trip Itinerary

Day 1: Drive from Pokhara to Nayapul and trek to Tikhedhunga, 1,450 m, 4 hrs

Day 2: Trek to Ghorepani, 2,850 m, 5 hrs

Day 3: Hike from Ghorepani to Poon Hill, 3,210 m and trek to Tadapani, 2,520 m, 5 to 6 Hrs

Day 4: Trek from Tadapani to Ghandruk, 1,950 m, 6 hrs

Day 5: Trek to Syauli Bazaar and drive to Pokhara, 1,530 m, 2 to 3 Hrs

Lower Mustang Trek

Lower Mustang Trek, also known as Jomsom Muktinath trek, is one of the beautiful treks in Annapurna and Mustang region. Anyone with a moderate level of fitness can complete this 5 days short trek in Nepal.

For those who don’t want to trek all the way up to high altitude, this is a perfect choice. Despite the low altitude, it offers numerous Trans-Himalayan cultural sites and the amazing countryside sceneries.

On this trek, you will pass through stunning landscapes and rhododendron forest and the world’s deepest gorge, the Kali Gandaki gorge. Moreover, you will pass through Jomsom and Kagbeni along with holy Hindu pilgrimage site, Muktinath which is an equally sacred place for Buddhists.

On the trek, you will witness the spectacular view of Annapurna I, Dhaulagiri, Nilgiri, and other peaks. Besides, you will also explore the centuries-old monasteries, local tribes, caves, etc.

Because of all these, the lower Mustang trek is one of the best short treks in Nepal.

Trip Itinerary

Day 01: Fly from Pokhara to Jomsom and trek to Kagbeni, 2,900 m, 6 hrs

Day 02: Trek to Jharkot, Visit to red Gompa, 3,520 m, 6 hrs

Day 03: Day trip to Muktinath, 3,710 m, 6 hrs

Day 04: Trek to Jomsom via Lupra valley, 2,790 m, 6 hrs

Day 05: Flight from Jomsom to Pokhara, 1,400 m, 30 minutes

Gosaikunda Trek

The Gosaikunda 5 days trek is one of the best short treks in Nepal. This trek gives you a glimpse into the diverse landscape, culture, and nature of Nepal.

The Gosaikunda trek is all about the Gosaikunda lake which lies at an altitude of 4,380 m This lake is a sacred place for both the Hindus and Buddhists.

Being one of the most surreal trekking destinations, this trek is a perfect combination of natural as well as a cultural tour of Nepal. With this trek, within a short period of time, you get to experience high altitude trek.

The 5-day trek provides you with amazing views of the snow-capped mountain peaks from day one. Moreover, you will pass through beautiful lush green forests of rhododendron, oak, pine, and birch.

Overall, this trek is ideal for those who are short on time. Also, you can modify the trek according to your preference.

Trip Itinerary

Day 01: Drive to Dhunche from Kathmandu, 2,000 m, 6 hrs drive

Day 02: Trek to Chandanbari, 3,580 m, 4 to 5 Hrs

Day 03: Trek to Gosaikunda, 4,380 m, 5 to 7 Hrs

Day 04: Trek back to Dhunche

Day 05: Return to Kathmandu

Mardi Himal Trek

Mardi Himal trek is one of the off the beaten trails in Nepal. Situated just east of Annapurna Base Camp, Mardi Himal is a hidden gem of Annapurna.

The trek officially opened in 2012 and is still a pristine region having few tea houses with basic facilities. Similarly, Mardi Himal trek is a short, relatively easy and unspoiled trek near Pokhara.

Cultural insight, beautiful rhododendron forest, and alpine landscape make it a beautiful journey.

You will witness spectacular views of Mardi Himal, Dhaulagiri, Machhapuchhre, Manaslu, and Hiuchuli.

Trip Itinerary

Day 01: Drive to Kade and trek to Forest Camp, 2,554 m, 7 hrs

Day 02: Trek to high camp, 3,980 m, 8 hrs

Day 03: Trek to viewpoint and rest at high/low camp, 4,500 m, 6 hrs

Day 04: Trek to Siding/Lumre, 1,700 m, 6 hrs

Day 05: Drive back to Pokhara, 1,400 m, 5 hrs

Dhampus-Sarangkot Trek

Dhampus- Sarangkot trek is a relatively easy trek in the periphery of Pokhara. This trek will take you to two villages, Dhampus and Sarangkot, in the northwest of Pokhara valley.

Due to the moderate nature of this trek, it is suitable both for elderly and young ones. This trek provides a wonderful view of the mountains in the Annapurna and Dhaulagiri range.

The Gurungs are hospitable people and hence you will be happy to witness their welcoming and friendly nature. Moreover, their food and drink are unique for visitor’s taste buds. In the evening, the locals here provide you with a glimpse into their age-old culture through music and dance.

Also not to forget, the view of the Phewa lake and the Pokhara valley is stunning from Dhampus and Sarangkot. Equally mesmerizing is the sunrise and sunset view. Overall, this trek offers you a beautiful and pleasing experience.

Trip Itinerary

Day 01: Drive to Pokhara (820 m), 6-7 hours, and transfer to hotel.

Day 02: Drive to Phedi (850 m), 30 minutes, and trek to Dhampus (1,770 m), 2-3 hours.

Day 03: Trek to Sarangkot (1,592 m), 5-6 hours.

Day 04: Trek to Pame (780 m), 2 hours, and drive to Pokhara (820 m), 20 minutes.

Day 05: Drive to Kathmandu (1,300 m), 6-7 hours drive

Kakani Shivapuri Trek

Kakani Shivapuri trek is another short and diverse 5 days trek in Nepal. This trek is within the Kathmandu valley. It is a quiet and more pristine destination which is suitable even for families with children.

With a pleasant drive about 25 km northwest of Kathmandu, the trek starts at Kakani. This trek offers excellent mountain views of Ganesh Himal, Langtang Himal, and the Annapurna ranges.

The trek offers a view of beautiful landscapes and great views of snowy peaks. And it highlights the lifestyle and culture of different people living near the Kathmandu valley.

Overall, the Kakani Shivapuri trek is a blend of wilderness and great scenery of Kathmandu valley.

Trip Itinerary

Day 01: Drive from Kathmandu to Kakani (1,982 m) and trek to AaleDanda, 4 to 5 Hrs

Day 02: Trek Aalendanda to Shivapuri (2,732 m), 5 to 6 hrs

Day 03: Trek Shivapuri to Chisapani (2,215 m), 4 to 5 hrs

Day 04: Trek Chisapani to Nagarkot (2,195 m), 5 to 6 hrs

Day 05: Trek Nagarkot to Banepa and drive back to Kathmandu, 4 to hrs

Things to Consider for 5 Days Treks in Nepal

  • Trekking in Nepal is possible all year round, however, Spring and Autumn is the best time. Hence, choose a suitable season.
  • Book your flights and hotels in advance during peak season.
  • Pack proper gear and clothing according to the season in order to make your trekking experience smooth and comfortable
  • Avoid monsoon seasons as the trails can be muddy and slippery.
  • While trekking, drink plenty of water to stay hydrated.
  • Walk slow and take your own pace
  • ATMs are not readily available besides in Kathmandu and Pokhara, hence carry enough cash.
  • Always reach out for help from the guide in case of any problem.
  • Even in the best season, the weather condition can affect your traveling schedule. So to be on the safe side, keep extra days.

Conclusion

Nepal is a popular country for its trekking options in the beautiful mountains. Along with it, the unique culture, breathtaking landscapes, and warm hospitality equally amaze you.

These 5 days treks in Nepal are perfect for people who have less time yet want to experience trekking in the Himalayas. These packages allow you to witness peaceful experience in nature away from the hustle and bustle of city life.

Each trekking package provides you with its unique beauty that will be worth your time, energy and money.

title: 3 Days Treks in Nepal
excerpt: Short treks are usually a 3 Days Treks in Nepal. This kind of trek is excellent for trekkers who have a short time duration for travel. It is also a very good option if you have a few days left for…
html:
Short treks are usually a 3 Days Treks in Nepal. This kind of trek is excellent for trekkers who have a short time duration for travel. It is also a very good option if you have a few days left for your international flight back to your country.

If you are a professional trekker and also want something extra besides your adventurous trek, then you can choose a short 3 days trek as well. And 3 days can offer you a lot more than you can expect.

Nepal is a small landlocked country but with a lot of travel options that you can choose from. In fact, 3 days trek in Nepal is also a popular way to explore the country.

For a short 3-days trek in Nepal, it is best if you go to nearby places to trek. Nepal offers a lot of trekking options for soulful trekkers. You can go to nearby places for trekking and enjoy most of it. Each nook and corner of Nepal offer something to explore.

What to Expect on a 3 Days Trek?

A 3-day trek is a great way to enjoy trekking in Nepal. However, it works best if you visit someplace nice to understand travel properly.

In most of the treks, you will be able to see the stunning mountain views, the lush greenery, and the authentic culture. This duration is enough for you to have a basic understanding of what Nepal has to offer. You can also meet new people, and enjoy a wide range of local cuisines.

3 days is an easier alternative for the trekking destinations that are possible to complete within a short time.

A 3-day trek is not safe or convenient for all kinds of trekking destinations. This is only suitable for easy and nearby destinations.

Some of the treks that fall in this category also include less walking and more driving. Because of the modes of transportation, there are even certain options that are far in distance but is possible within 3 days.

Please submit your inquiry using the form below. Our team will get back to you as soon as possible.

How Difficult can 3 Days Treks in Nepal be?

3-day trek options are usually the kind of treks that fall on the category of ‘Easy’ when it comes to the difficulty level. But there are some moderate level treks that fall in a 3-day trek. So, this is definitely not something that is suitable for all kinds of the trek.

There are a number of treks designed for 3 days. And, as per the time and demand of the trekkers, some longer treks are also possible in 3 days.

The difficulty of the 3 days treks depends on the route, itinerary, and time of the year you plan to trek.

Shorter treks are great for a family that includes children. These are usually relaxing treks and a great way to enjoy a new country.

Expenses of 3 Days Treks in Nepal

Transportation

Most common modes of transportation are bus and jeeps. The price depends on the distance you travel. Sometimes you might have to include domestic flights which increase the total tour cost.

Transportation is an important factor that increases your expenses. Well, if you choose to take local transportation, these are quite affordable compared to hiring private cars.

Accommodation

Accommodation includes the place you will stay at. Mostly, Nepal is famous for teahouse trekking and the expenses depend on the type of accommodation you go for.

Teahouse trekking accommodation is quite affordable. They are simple and comfortable plus available in the reasonable prices.

You can choose fancy places to stay overnight or you can also choose a standard room with attached bathrooms. The choice is yours and the expense varies accordingly.

Sometimes, the availability might make you opt for the kind of accommodations that you did not ask for. In these cases, advance booking works best.

Personal Expense

Personal Expenses can be of two kinds: expense for the trek and expenses during the trek.

Expenses for the trek includes all your necessary gears. For example items like hiking boots, trekking pole, clothing, personal hygiene, toiletries, etc.

Some of the expenses that incur are for souvenirs, facilities, meals, accommodations and so on.

Popular 3 Days Treks in Nepal

Balthali Village Trek

Balthali Village Trek is one of the shortest and the nearest trek from Kathmandu. Balthali village is only 40 km away from Kathmandu and is on the elevation on 1600 km. It doesn’t take much longer to reach there and this trek is possible in 3 days.

Balthali Village is a place for you if you are a nature lover. It is a great place to witness the countryside of Nepal that is closest to the capital.

On the first day, you will go to Dhulikhel from Kathmandu. From here, you will hike for 3 hours towards Namo Buddha, a site that is important for the Buddhist Community.  Again, after a 3- hour hike will take you to the beautiful Balthali Village.

On the second day, you will explore Balthali Village. This quick little escape from the busy city life will gift you the incredible view of the Himalayas. The lush forest to Mahabharat range from Pada Gaon is absolutely blissful.

You will make your return on the third day. You will head to Panauti. Panauti is an old Newari village where you can explore many historic temples. Panauti is also one of the most traditional Newar villages that have managed to remain uninfluenced by modernity.

Then you will drive back to Kathmandu.

This 3-day trek will show you the natural beauty, incredible view of mountain range and the lifestyle of local people. This trek is affordable and you can enjoy some of the best accommodation in Nepal.

Ghandruk Trek

Ghandruk Trek is another easy option for quick trekking in Annapurna region. It is an easy trek that is possible in 3 days. It is a beautiful trekking destination in the Annapurna region.

It gives you a chance to experience the Gurung ethnic community of Nepal. And the astounding picturesque view of the mountain ranges makes the trek worthwhile.

This trek begins from Pokhara, the city of lakes.  On the first day, you will head to Phedi from Pokhara. After trekking for about 5 hours from Phedi, you reach Toalka where you will stay for the night.

On the second day, you will trek for about 4 hours until you reach the Gurung Village of Ghandruk. You will stay overnight at Ghandruk.

On the last day, you will enjoy a gorgeous sunrise where the golden rays of sunlight hit the peaks of Mt. Annapurna and Mt. Machhapuchre.

After the heavenly sunrise, you will climb down to Birenthati from Shyauli Bazar. On the way back, you can also explore the Gurung museum.

Then, you will finally reach Nayapul. It will take about 5 – 6 hours drive back to Pokhara from Nayapul.

There is also another route to Ghandruk Village. On the first day, you will trek from Pokhara to Ghandruk. On the second day, you will trek from Ghandruk to Pothana and the last day you will trek back to Pokhara.

However, the first one is easier.

Ghandruk Trek is suitable for trekkers of all age groups. It is also a great trekking package for short family trekking trips.

Ghorepani Poonhill Trek

Ghorepani Poonhill Trek includes the route of Magar village and is possible within 3 days. Actually, this is a shortened version of 5 days trek. You can reach the elevation on 3,210 m, Poon Hill, in 3 days.

PoonHill is a famous trekking destination for magnificent views of the sunrise over the Himalayas.

The journey begins from Pokhara. From Pokhara, you will drive to Nayapul. From Nayapul, the trek begins.

On the first day, you will reach Nayapul and then trek to Tikhedhunga where you will stay overnight. You will trek early morning after breakfast on the second day.

From Tikhedhunga you will trek to Ghorepani. You will walk past the Ulleri Village and witness the simplicity of Magar community. After reaching Ghorepani, you will stay there overnight.

The third day is where you will walk up to Poonhill. Here you get to see the beautiful panorama of mountains from Annapurna ranges and others like Mt, Dhaulagiri, Mt. Machhapuchre and Nilgiri. Then you will come back to Nayapul and drive back to Pokhara.

Along the journey, you will enjoy the warm hospitality of locals from the Gurung and Magar community.

Kalinchowk Trek

About 149 km away from Kathmandu, to the North Eastern side of Nepal, there is a religious short trek to the Kalinchowk Bhagwati Temple. Kalinchowk is in the Dolakha District of Nepal and the Bhagwati Mandir is on the elevation of 3,790 m

Kalinchowk Trek is slightly difficult than other treks. Regardless, this famous pilgrimage site is suitable for all age groups. The temple of Kalinchowk Bhagwati is atop a hill from Kuri Village.

On the first day, you head towards Kuri Village form Kathmandu. You can either take a 4-hour drive to Charikot and trek for about 5 – 6 hours to Kuri. Or, you can also drive straight to the Kuri Village which is 150 km away from Kathmandu.

You will stay overnight at Kuri Village. The next day, you will hike up to the hill to reach the Hindu pilgrimage site. The hike is only for about an hour, but it’s best if you start early so that you can enjoy the sunrise.

Atop the hill, you can see the views of mountain ranges of Langtang Himal, Ganesh Himal, Gauri Shanker, etc. The temple is of Hindu goddess Kali.

After coming back down you will stay overnight at Kuri. On the third and last day, you will drive back to Kathmandu. It attracts a lot of local tourists. It is a fascinating trek and can be easily done throughout the year.

Kathmandu Valley Trek

Kathmandu Valley is famous for a  number of temples. The 3 days Kathmandu Valley Trek has cultural exploration and short hikes around Kathmandu.

On the first day, you can either choose to explore some of the oldest and most popular temples and cultural heritage sites. Or, choose to do a Sundarijal – Chisapani Trek.

The cultural aspects cover some of the popular cultural heritage sites. Some of them are the Kathmandu, Patan, and  Bhaktapur Durbar Square and Pashupatinath Darshan.

On the second day, you will trek to Nagarkot. From Nagarkot, you can see the picturesque mountain ranges of Langtang, Everest, and Kanchenjunga as well.

You will stay at Nagarkot overnight.

On the third and last day, you will take a 3 and half hour trek to Changunarayan. Then, you will come back to your hotel in Kathmandu.

Kathmandu Valley Trek might sound normal but this capital city offers you the richest Nepali culture. You can also devour the authentic taste Newari cuisines. Traveling here is suitable in every season and everyone can visit here.

Don’t Miss Out On

The options are wide and every destination has its own beauty. Amongst all them, you cannot miss out on:

  • The best accommodation in the good price of Balthali Village Trek
  • The sunrise and sunset of Ghandruk and Ghorepani Poonhill Trek
  • The myth of the cultural beliefs of Kalinchowk Trek and the famous yak churpi on the way down to Kuri
  • The richness of the ancient history and culture of Kathmandu Valley Trek

Conclusion

You can choose the 3 days treks in Nepal and get the opportunity to explore so much that seems impossible within 3 days.

From the simplicity of the locals to the view of some of the highest mountains. It is a lot affordable too. Shorter treks give you a chance to explore the place with a small budget too.

title: 1 Day Treks in Nepal
excerpt: Nepal is a trekking paradise. The country homes a number of treks which ranges from high altitude long treks to lower latitude short and easy trek. 1 day treks in Nepal are among the short and easy…
html:
Nepal is a trekking paradise. The country homes a number of treks which ranges from high altitude long treks to lower latitude short and easy trek.

1 day treks in Nepal are among the short and easy treks in lower altitudes.

These treks are a great option for those who want to experience trekking yet do not want to spend many days on the trail.

These treks are kind-of relaxing and family treks. You can trek solo or with friends or families to enjoy the beauty of Nepal in a day without much physical effort.

With just a small backpack with the necessary essentials, you are good to take this trek.

You will drive till the trailhead from where you will start hiking. Away from the crowd, these one-day treks are probably the best way to connect with nature.

Let us guide you with the best one-day treks in Nepal, within the short distance of Kathmandu and Pokhara.

Nagarkot Trek

The route from Nagarkot to Dhulikhel is probably one of the best short hiking trails in the Kathmandu valley.

This is among the popular 1 day treks in Nepal will take you through exotic forests and traditional small hamlets with stunning views of the Himalayas.

Here, you will trek from Nagarkot in Bhaktapur District to the hill station at Dhulikhel, an ancient Newari village.

You can take this trek any time of the year as it is relatively at low altitudes, reaching a maximum height of around 2,200 m To do this trek, one does not need to be the fittest person since it is an easy trek to the hill. In this trek, you will walk for around 6 to 7 hrs.

The town of Dhulikhel lies around 30 km to the east of Kathmandu. And is one of the oldest towns in the area.

Please submit your inquiry using the form below. Our team will get back to you as soon as possible.

Chandragiri Trek

Chandragiri Day trek is an easy trek that starts around 12 km from Thamel in Kathmandu. This is one of the most beautiful hiking trails that is new in the valley.

In this trek, you will pass through primeval forests and get stunning views of the Himalayas.

The trek is mostly uphill though the climb is a low gradient. This trek allows you plenty of opportunities to stop and rest. You can look out on the beauty of the view over the valley along with the mighty Himalayas.

Chandragiri Hill is an exquisite site that offers one of the best views out over the Kathmandu to the mountains. It lies at an altitude of 2,551 m above the sea level. And is an excellent place to click great pictures of the sunset or sunrise.

The hill is also one of the natural sites in the Kathmandu valley. The jungle surrounding the Chandragiri hillock is rich in diverse flora and fauna that has a high medicinal value.

Champa Devi Hill Trek

Champa Devi is one of the famous short hikes around the Kathmandu valley. The hill at Champa Devi is the third highest in the valley area.

With a maximum height around 2,278 m, hiking to the top of this beautiful hill is nothing but a delightful experience away from the city.

For those who are short on time, but want to see the best of the Kathmandu valley, there is probably no better place than Champa Devi. Here, you will get amazing vista over the valley.

The trek starts at Banyan which is about 45 minutes from Thamel in Kathmandu. The trek to the top of the hill takes around 3 to 4 hours. This can take longer depending on how many times you take a pause to look at the magnificent views.

At the top of the hill is the site of the Champa Devi Shrine. Here you will also find a small Buddhist monastery. The route back follows the trail on the other side of the hill. And it ends in the small village of Macche Gau.

This is an easy trek and anyone with an average level of fitness can do this trek. Moreover, even families with kids or elderly can easily take this beautiful trek.

Nagarjuna Hill Trek

Nagarjuna trek is among ideal 1 day treks in Nepal for those who have an interest in some of the Buddhist associations with Nepal. The Nagarjuna hill lies outside the capital at 2,128 m in the Shivapuri Nagarjun National park.

This Hill is beautifully surrounded by jungle which is the home to the wild boars, deer, monkeys and thousands of species of birds.

The trek starts from the Fulbari gate of the park. And then you will slowly walk to the top of the hill which takes around 3 to 4 hrs. It is also an easy trek as the climb is gradual and rises only by around 700 m above the valley floors.

The top of the hill is the location of a famous Buddhist monastery that is a pilgrimage site in Nepal for devout Buddhists. The hill, originally known as Jamacho was once the meditation site of an Indian Buddhist teacher Nagarjuna. He came to Nepal to teach Buddhism to the people.

The trek back to Phulbari gate takes around another 2 hours making it a total of 5 to 6 hours of trekking with a pleasant stop at the top in the monastery. During this trek, we recommend you take your own food or water, as there are no tea houses or restaurants within the national park area.

Ranikot Village Trek

One of the great one day treks is off the beaten Ranikot village trek. Kathmandu has several awesome viewpoints that provide an amazing view of the Kathmandu valley.

Besides the valley view, these vantage points offer views of the high hilly folds to the snow-capped Himalayas to the north.

Hence the Ranikot village trek is also one among those that take you to the vantage point of Ranikot pass where you will get the spectacular view

With the 15 km drive from the Kathmandu city, you will start the trek from Suryabinayak of Bhaktapur. And cross the Ranikot pass at 1,917 m And end the day in Newari Ethnic city called Sanga.

This day hike will also give you the experience of jungle walk with birds chirping, excellent view, village lifestyle of the local people etc.

Overall Ranikot village trek offers you unmatchable chance to experience the real village hiking. Without going too far away from the capital city.

Dhampus Trek

Dhampus is a day hike in Pokhara and is one of the best ways to spend your time around Annapurna Himalayan range.

The one day hike starts after an hour drive from Kande village. From Kande to Australian Base Camp the trail leads gently steep and demands about one and half hour walk.

The height of the Australian base camp is 2,100 m, which is a normal height for a beginner. You can enjoy the stunning view of Annapurna South, Hiunchuli, Lamjung Himal and fishtail.

After exploring and taking some time to click pictures in front of the amazing mountains you will hike down to Dhampus village.

Dhampus is a beautiful Gurung village with majestic views of the Annapurna range. In this trek, you will also get to witness the culture of the local Gurung people.

From Dhampus you will walk all the way down to Phedi where you will take a ride back to Pokhara. This trek is possible all year round and the maximum length of the trek is about 5 to 6 hours.

Thulakot Hill Trek

Thulakot is one of the best viewpoints in Pokhara where you can enjoy great sceneries and vistas.

Thulakot trek is not just for the Himalayan views but also to experience the mountain life of the Nepalese people. The trek starts from Bijayapur after 30 minutes drive from Pokhara.

In most places, you will see many tourists, but here you will see fewer people. The view along the way up to Thulakot is simply amazing. With great landscapes and view of the entire Pokhara valley.

Once you reach near the Thulakot hill, you will stand face to face with the Annapurna range, Lamjung, Manaslu and the fishtail.

The Begnas lake is another main attraction of this trip which you will see from the top of Thulakot. And, the hike will end at Begnas Lake.

Overall, this 5 hours Thulakot Hill trek consists of forest, villages, scenery, lifestyle, lakes and the mountains. Hence, this trek is definitely worth taking when in Pokhara.

Sarangkot-Naudanda Trek

Sarangkot- Naudanda Trek is another popular 1 day treks in Nepal that you can take in Pokhara. This short one day hike to Naudanda and Sarangkot not only gives you the spectacular mountain views but you will also get to experience the ethnic culture of mountain communities as well.

Your adventure begins with a drive from Pokhara to Phedi. Once you reach Phedi you will start your trek and head to Naudanda.

On way, you will stop once in a while to catch your breath and soak in the views. You get the inspiring views of the snow-capped peaks and the mountain villages.

A gentle ascent from Phedi takes you to Naudanda, a Gurung village. You will then walk past paddy fields and settlements with whitewashed cottages. As you follow an easy trail you will reach Sarangkot.

Sarangkot at 1,600 m is one of the most popular Himalayan viewpoints in Nepal. Many people come here to catch the sunrise view, 360-degree views of the Himalayas- Annapurna, Lamjung Himal, Macchapucchre are spectacular.

After embracing the moment and spending a blissful hour or two you will head down from Sarangkot to Pokhara.

Peace Pagoda Trek

World Peace Pagoda lies on the top of a hill on the southern shore of Phewa lake of Pokhara. Besides being a magnificent sight in itself, it is a great point to view the spectacular views of the Annapurna range, lakes, and the Pokhara city.

This stupa is the symbol of peace where there is an installation of huge idols of Lord Buddha from Japan, Sri Lanka, and Thailand.

This trek will guarantee to make you feel at peace and enjoy the tranquillity with the sights it has to offer. On this one day trek, you will cross the lake by one of the many wooden boats. And then climb the stone stairs through the beautiful forest.

On the way, you will pass through some villages and meet the friendly local people. Walking for about two hours, you will finally reach the top. The beautiful white stupa with the breathtaking views of lake, city, and mountains will simply spellbind you.

You will then stay there for some time. And then head down through another route that goes towards David’s fall.

Kahun Danda Trek

Kahun Danda is another enchanting hill north of Pokhara and takes about two and a half hours to reach there. Normally people from Pokhara call this place as a Dharahara of Pokhara. The place displays magical mountain views and also a complete view of the Pokhara valley.

Moreover, the sunrise view from Kahun Danda is better from the lower Sarangkot viewpoint. Very few people know about this place and hence it is very quiet and peaceful for day hiking.

The trail starts from near the army barrack at Phulbari across Mahendrapool and climbs slowly up a slope. The essential view from the top of the hill is the panoramic view of the Annapurna range along with the flat span of Pokhara valley.

Normally this is a one day trek. But you can make it 2 days if you have an interest in spending some time with the villagers. The Kahun Danda at 1,520 m has a ruined fort on the summit as well as view tower.

The mesmerizing change of colors after the sunrise on the Annapurna will definitely be a worthy experience on this trek.

Note: One of the advantages of the one-day treks in Nepal is that they are possible all year round. However, summers can be a little wet because of monsoon rains getting heavier in July and August. Spring and Autumn are the best seasons. And with the coldest day time temperature being as low as 18 degrees, cold is not really an issue in these one-day treks.

Conclusion

Regardless of any requirements, there is a trek for everyone in Nepal. With plenty of options to choose from, Nepal is sure to spoil you with choices.

All these one day treks are easy and do not have altitude risks. Hence, with only a short time in your hand, these one-day trek is a perfect getaway to fulfill your trekking experience.
